The program failed only because the word "input" in two comments tripped the forbidden-construct filter. I removed it from those comments; the circuit is unchanged.

The topology still looks able to meet every spec. The figures below are my hand estimates, not simulation results:

| Spec | Required | Estimate |
|---|---|---|
| Transconductance | about 90 µS minimum for 26 MHz at 0.55 pF | about 170 µS → GBW ≈ 49 MHz |
| DC gain | ≥ 51 dB | about 54 dB (tightest margin) |
| -3 dB bandwidth | ≥ 66 kHz | about 100 kHz |
| Power | ≤ 76 µW | about 58 µW |
| Output DC level | 0.45–1.35 V | about 1.05 V |
| Output swing | ≥ 0.41 V | about 0.55 to 1.6 V |

To add some gain margin, I raised the initial PMOS load length from 1.5 to 2.0 µm.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 26e-6),
    "gmidc": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # NMOS cascode
    "Lc":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load
    "Lp":    (2.0, 0.8, 3.0),
    "gmidt": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # tail / bias mirror
    "vcas":  (1.02, 0.9, 1.15),      # cascode gate voltage (divider)
    "Rdiv":  (900e3, 400e3, 2e6),    # total divider resistance
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["Itail"] / 2.0

    # diff pair: tail node from its own Vgs (body effect iterated)
    vtail = 0.2
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=0.25, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(0.08, vin - m1.vgs)
    # cascode source at vcas - vgs_c
    vx = 0.4
    for _ in range(3):
        mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=0.3, vsb=vx)
        vx = p["vcas"] - mc.vgs
    # PMOS mirror load
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.8)
    vout_dc = vdd - mp.vgs
    mc_vds = max(0.1, vout_dc - vx)
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=mc_vds, vsb=vx)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=max(0.1, vx - vtail), vsb=vtail)
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=mp.vgs)
    # tail mirror from ibias
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], 1.0, p["Itail"], vds=max(0.1, vtail))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], 1.0, iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # divider: vdd - Ra - vcas - Rb - vref - Rc - vss
    R = p["Rdiv"]
    Rc = R * vin / vdd
    Rb = R * (p["vcas"] - vin) / vdd
    Ra = R - Rb - Rc

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vin", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "vcas", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "vcas", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M5", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.R("RS", "ibias", "nb", 1e3)
    n.R("RA", "vdd", "vcas", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "vcas", "vref", Rb)
    n.R("RC", "vref", "vss", Rc)

    # predictions
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs + mc.gds) / (m1.gds * mc.gds)
    gout = mp.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A = m1.gm / gout
    ctot = cl + mp.cdd + mc.cdd + 20e-15
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * ctot)
    vmin = vx + mc.vdsat + 0.05
    vmax = vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vmax - vmin
    power = vdd * (iref + p["Itail"] + vdd / R)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
```
